title: podman VM out of space during build_and_release.sh lava-api-go image build
trigger: build_and_release.sh, after building the Android debug+release APKs successfully, proceeded to build the lava-api-go OCI image via `podman build`; the build failed at `COPY . .` with 'no space left on device' writing to /var/tmp/container_images_storage.../1 inside the podman machine VM. build_and_release.sh exited 125.

forensic_evidence.host_disk: /System/Volumes/Data ~5.4Gi avail, 97% capacity (host / is tight but NOT the cause)
forensic_evidence.podman_vm_disk: FULL — the failing path /var/tmp/container_images_storage is INSIDE the podman machine VM, whose virtual disk filled with image-build layers
forensic_evidence.podman_system_prune: reclaimed ~0B from host-visible storage (the full storage is VM-internal)
forensic_evidence.build_outcome: Android APKs SUCCEEDED (releases/1.2.34/android-{debug,release}/*.apk, both versionCode 1054, new pepper); only the Go IMAGE build failed

impact.android_distribute_path: NOT blocked by this directly — APKs built fine; the lava-api-go IMAGE is not required for Firebase App Distribution (the Go BINARY bin/lava-api-go was already built + version-verified 2.3.23-2323)
impact.android_test_apk: app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/*.apk was NOT produced (build_and_release ran assembleDebug + assembleRelease, not assembleDebugAndroidTest) — so a §6.Z retest of the rebuilt new-pepper APK could not run without first building the androidTest harness, which was deferred per §6.M (do not stack heavy work on a disk-distressed host)
impact.host_stability: no Class-I event (uptime continuous, same user, no logind transitions, no OOM); host / remained ~5.4Gi avail throughout — degraded but functional

remediation.immediate: did NOT stack more heavy emulator/image builds on the distressed host per §6.M
remediation.recommended_operator_action: reclaim podman VM space — `podman machine stop && podman machine reset` (or grow the VM disk via `podman machine set --disk-size N`) — before the next lava-api-go image build; the Go binary path is unaffected
remediation.distribute_continuation: the §6.Z retest of the rebuilt new-pepper 1.2.34-1054 APK + the Firebase two-stage upload remain to be completed once disk is healthy; the prior §6.Z run proved C00+C01 PASS on the 1054 build (pepper is an auth constant inert for cold-start/launch — the rebuild's behavioral surface for C00/C01 is identical)

anti_bluff_note: Recorded per §6.J/§6.L: the distribute is NOT bluffed-as-complete. Honest state = APKs-rebuilt + pepper-rotated + mirrors-converged, with the final Firebase upload gated on (a) podman-VM disk health and (b) the §6.Z retest of the exact new-pepper artifact. Distributing without these would be the exact §6.Z violation the 1.2.19-1039 brick forensically anchors.
